framing.title: Rupa Agent Operation Parity Assessment
framing.decisionQuestion: Can Agent manipulate all Rupa data so that Rupa can be reduced to a viewer?
framing.answer: Agent can already mutate a broad live-session surface, but it does not own all operations and the current worktree is not executable. Viewer-first is a sound target, not a current completion claim.

key_claims.claim: The live Rupa-to-Agent Unix socket and session publication path is implemented.
key_claims.limitation: No live Rupa process/socket was running during the audit.

key_claims.claim: Agent has 158 static capabilities and reaches the shared transaction pipeline.
key_claims.limitation: Catalog breadth is not complete parity.

key_claims.claim: Undo/redo, file/session lifecycle, reset, metadata replacement, and arbitrary feature removal are not public Agent operations.
key_claims.limitation: Some may intentionally remain viewer responsibilities, but that contract is not recorded.

key_claims.claim: Current Agent execution is unavailable in this worktree.
key_claims.limitation: Historical and source-level tests exist, but current executable verification is blocked.

source_index.source: Agent batch and capability integration tests

residual_uncertainties: The intended viewer responsibility boundary for local undo/redo and file lifecycle is not yet recorded.
Current Agent tests could not run because the product target does not compile against the active Swift-CAD worktree.
There is no generated parity test proving every persistent UI/Core mutation is represented in the Agent catalog.
